purpose: New development intervention derived from historical all-pay positive control. No formal map or dataset reused in an independent-strength claim.
source_freeze: 4a4677c9329c1a8d5cb8bc0916dc331dc952219b (all-top-five research); all 16 original parent source maps used in the 64 native branch pairs for opportunity diagnostic.
selection: First eligible frame per inclusive window; stable ascending string worker uid within frame. Accept an affordable plant or seizure under the exact V1 joint command after other existing hires and planter payment reservations. No own worker or recruited base shares resulting position, feasible pay/defer commands differ only for this planter after actual autoregressive prefix re-decode. If V1 already ordered payment consume the window without changing action. The defer alternative only needs to exist; deterministic NESW order for existence, no effect on which action executes. Original 64-root full-window ranking and its effect size do not transfer.
pay: At each selected opportunity execute the legal pay command only, keeping all other real Sapling decisions. No rule on outcomes, enemy orders, seed, cash forecast or previous payment success. Maximum two selected opportunities per game; all other frames original.
prior_gate: Before any new game, require verified no equivalent old whole-game policy; on all 32 chronological recorded parent trajectories (16 maps and both seats) observe at least 8 of 64 windows with changed payments, changes on at least 4 maps, and at least 2 archived opportunities demonstrated actual charge after a changed command when replayed against that source frame's simultaneously committed opponent command. This last factual one-step check is offline and never a selection input. Fail any condition: stop.

new_dev.adjudication: All eight finishes, original default search / temperature / official extinction; official state replay and complete action tapes; mean seat-paired official margin change + own/rival terminal, signed gross tree and expense/deposit/dead cargo, miss rates and upper-limit two trigger doses. Two-map diagnostic; no extra run on a losing result. Freeze actual package before games. Stop if duplicate registration or uncleared map; no role in formal promotion.
